summary: First full run. Backend: 22/22 pytest pass via the public URL. That covers photos upload/fetch plus device scoping, MediaPipe vision on a real person photo (1 person, 33 landmarks), edit render preview/export (filter, adjust, crop, rotate, flip, Hindi text, stickers, frame), Gemini edit suggest, Nano Banana enhance/remove_bg/blur_bg/replace_bg, carousel (3 sliced 1080x1350) and collage compose, presets CRUD, projects CRUD/duplicate/scoping, ABYA SSE chat in Hindi/Bhojpuri/Hinglish plus a photo-attached chat, the session/messages/delete flow, a TTS->mp3->STT round trip and content generation. Frontend at 390x844: Home, Pose AI (search, chips, favourites, detail, Use in Camera), Camera permission state, ABYA (language sheet, streamed reply via suggestion, typed follow-up, history delete), Projects (rename/duplicate/delete/open), Editor (tools, slider, filters, undo, crop, Hindi text, preset save, AI smart suggestions, Next -> share with Hindi caption generation) and Studio (collage templates, text add plus undo, carousel slides +, export -> 3 slides on share) all work. One crash fixed: the Camera tab threw an uncaught error on web from the expo-sensors Accelerometer. No deprecated Expo packages detected (expo-audio and expo-camera are used).

minor.issue: No try/except around the LLM call or extract_json. An LLM or JSON parse failure returns a raw 500 instead of a 502 with a message. The other AI endpoints handle this.

No X-Device-Id is required, so anyone can call these and consume LLM credits. The TTS audio is kept in an in-memory OrderedDict: it is lost on backend restart or reload and is not shared across workers.
There is no photo delete endpoint, and DELETE /projects leaves orphaned photos (originals, exports, AI results). Storage grows without bound.

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught 'this._nativeModule.addListener is not a function' from Accelerometer.addListener. On web, isAvailableAsync returns true but the shim has no addListener, which showed a red error overlay. Fixed by wrapping the call in try/catch.

styles.target has width '23.5%' plus gap 8, which comes to more than 100% at 390px. The grid wraps to 3 per row and leaves about 90px empty on the right; the 'Instagram Story' label is also truncated. Use ~22.5% width or compute the tile size from the container width.

issues: The meta style uses textTransform 'capitalize', so the date reads '2 Minutes Ago'. Capitalise only the type.
The 'AI photography assistant' subtitle wraps to 2 cramped lines at 390px next to 4 header buttons. Use numberOfLines={1} or shorten it.
Once, after Editor Next, the 'Preview & share' title rendered in a serif fallback font (seen 1 of 3 times). The computed font is SpaceGrotesk, so it may be a font-flash on web.
'Start a shoot' (camera icon) goes to /poses, not /camera. Probably intended ('Pick a pose' first), but the camera icon suggests the camera opens.

react_native_issues.issue: Accelerometer.addListener throws on the web preview. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/camera.tsx:100. Guarded with try/catch by the testing agent; consider skipping it when Platform.OS === 'web'.

action_items: Fix the share target grid width so 4 tiles fit per row (app/share/[id].tsx:172).
Wrap /api/edit/suggest in try/except and return 502 with a message, as the other AI endpoints do.
Optionally require X-Device-Id on the tts/stt/vision endpoints, and move the TTS cache to storage or the DB.
Add photo cleanup when a project is deleted, or a photo delete endpoint.
Minor UI polish: Projects date capitalisation, ABYA header subtitle wrapping.
Review the camera.tsx accelerometer guard (Platform check) that the testing agent added.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 1004 lines (over 700): split it into routers (photos, edit, ai, compose, projects, abya, content) plus image utils.
STT returns {text: ''} silently for audio under 2000 bytes. Fine, but the UI should show a 'didn't catch that' message.
Bhojpuri/Maithili are mapped to 'hi' for STT, which is acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows work; 1 crash fixed, 1 layout bug)

seed_data_creation: UI device TEST_ui_device_t1 with 3 TEST_ projects (created by seed_ui_device.py, cleaned up by id with cleanup_ui_device.py). Pytest devices are TEST_dev_*. Their projects, presets and sessions are deleted; their photos remain because no delete endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_posemate_api.py -k 'not ai_process' (about 95s) and -k ai_process -n 0 (about 40s). For UI, set localStorage pm.device = JSON.stringify('<device>') then reload, and seed with python tests/seed_ui_device.py <device>. Camera and mic can't be tested headless. Creating files under /app/backend triggers a uvicorn reload, which wipes the TTS cache.
rca_of_issue: Camera web crash: expo-sensors web Accelerometer reports available (DeviceMotionEvent exists in Chromium) but the native module shim has no addListener, so the useEffect in camera.tsx threw an uncaught promise error. Mitigation: try/catch plus .catch on isAvailableAsync (applied).
